name: setup-manaflow-ai-omnibar-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, after the two browsers whose chrome gets out of the way. One band of chrome at fixed heights (a 28 pt control in a 36 pt band), one colour with a neutral highlight on the selected tab and row, hairlines instead of shades, and every corner derived from the address field's 8 pt: a chip inside it is 6, a pane around it is 12. No glass, no goo. A second pair of themes (omnibar-two) puts the sidebar and tab strip one step darker. Built on Hush's colours. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
